# @liaugust/monobank-sdk

> Unofficial, strict, runtime-validated TypeScript SDK for Monobank Public,
> Personal, and Acquiring API endpoints. Supports Node.js 22.12.0+, ESM,
> CommonJS, and modern browser bundlers. Zod Mini validates every successful
> JSON response.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@liaugust/monobank-sdk
Repository: https://github.com/liaugust/monobank-typescript-sdk
API reference: https://github.com/liaugust/monobank-typescript-sdk/blob/main/docs/API.md
License: MIT

## Use the package

Install with `pnpm add @liaugust/monobank-sdk` or
`npm install @liaugust/monobank-sdk`.

Import only from `@liaugust/monobank-sdk`. Choose the client by credential
family; do not use the authenticated clients for public calls.

```ts
import {
  MonobankPersonalClient,
  MonobankPublicClient,
} from "@liaugust/monobank-sdk";

const publicApi = new MonobankPublicClient();
const personal = new MonobankPersonalClient({
  token: validatedConfig.monobankToken,
});
```

Use `MonobankAcquiringClient` with a separate Acquiring token.

## Client methods

- `publicApi.bank.getSync(options?)`: public `/bank/sync`; no `X-Token`; returns
  `Promise<BankSync>`.
- `publicApi.currency.getRates(options?)`: public `/bank/currency`; no `X-Token`;
  returns `Promise<readonly CurrencyRate[]>`.
- `personal.client.getInfo(options?)`: authenticated `/personal/client-info`;
  returns `Promise<ClientInfo>`; upstream limit is one call per 60 seconds.
- `personal.statements.get(input, options?)`: authenticated statements; returns
  `Promise<readonly StatementItem[]>`; maximum inclusive window is 2,682,000
  seconds; `Date` inputs become Unix seconds.
- `personal.webhooks.set(input, options?)`: authenticated webhook mutation;
  accepts an absolute HTTP(S) URL or `""` to remove it; never retried
  automatically.
- `parsePersonalWebhookEvent(input)`: validates webhook JSON shape; does not
  authenticate the sender.
- `acquiring.merchant.getDetails(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/details`; returns `Promise<MerchantDetails>`.
- `acquiring.statements.get(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/statement`; accepts required `from`, optional `to`, and
  optional submerchant terminal `code`; returns `Promise<AcquiringStatement>`
  whose readonly `list` is ordered newest first.
- `acquiring.submerchants.list(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/submerchant/list`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringSubmerchantList>` with a readonly list of terminal codes,
  IBANs, and optional owner details.
- `acquiring.qr.list(options?)`: authenticated `/api/merchant/qr/list`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringQrCashierList>` with a readonly list of `shortQrId`,
  `qrId`, `amountType`, and `pageUrl`; safe GET eligible for configured
  retries.
- `acquiring.qr.getDetails(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/qr/details`; requires a nonempty string `qrId` without
  surrounding whitespace and rejects with `MonobankValidationError` before
  Fetch otherwise; returns `Promise<AcquiringQrDetails>` for activated QR
  cashiers only, so a cashier returned by `acquiring.qr.list()` can still fail
  with status 404; pass `qrId`, not `shortQrId`. `invoiceId` is documented as
  present only while an amount is set and `amount`/`ccy` may be omitted for the
  same reason, so a successful response may carry `shortQrId` alone; safe GET
  eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.employees.list(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/employee/list`; returns `Promise<AcquiringEmployeeList>` with
  employees eligible for tips; safe GET eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.wallet.list(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/wallet`; requires `walletId`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringWallet>` with a readonly list of tokenized cards; safe GET.
- `acquiring.wallet.pay(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/wallet/payment`; charges a stored `cardToken`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringCardPayment>` carrying `tdsUrl` when 3-D Secure is
  required; mutating, never retried.
- `acquiring.wallet.deleteCard(input, options?)`: authenticated HTTP DELETE to
  `/api/merchant/wallet/card`; returns `Promise<void>`; mutating, never
  retried.
- `acquiring.invoices.payDirect(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/invoice/payment-direct`; accepts raw `cardData` with `pan`,
  `exp`, and `cvv`, which places the caller in PCI DSS scope; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringCardPayment>`; mutating, never retried.
- `acquiring.invoices.syncPayment(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/invoice/sync-payment`; requires exactly one of `cardData`,
  `applePay`, or `googlePay`, all of which are PCI DSS material; returns
  `Promise<Invoice>`; mutating, never retried.
- `acquiring.qr.resetAmount(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/qr/reset-amount`; POSTs `{ qrId }` to clear the amount set on
  a QR cashier; returns `Promise<void>` because Monobank acknowledges with an
  empty payload; mutating, so it is never retried automatically.
- `acquiring.webhooks.getPublicKey(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/pubkey`; returns `Promise<AcquiringWebhookPublicKey>`; caller
  owns caching and refresh after signature verification fails.
- `verifyAcquiringWebhookSignature(input)`: authenticates exact raw body bytes
  against the `X-Sign` ASN.1 DER signature using built-in Web Crypto; returns
  `Promise<boolean>` and requires no additional runtime dependency.
- `acquiring.invoices.create(input, options?)`: creates a hosted Acquiring
  invoice; returns `Promise<NewInvoice>`; never retried automatically.
- `acquiring.invoices.getStatus(input, options?)`: returns `Promise<Invoice>`
  for an `invoiceId`; safe GET eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.invoices.cancel(input, options?)`: full or partial payment
  cancellation; returns `Promise<InvoiceCancellation>`; never retried
  automatically.
- `acquiring.invoices.remove(input, options?)`: invalidates an unpaid invoice;
  returns `Promise<void>`; never retried automatically.
- `acquiring.invoices.finalize(input, options?)`: captures a held amount;
  returns `Promise<InvoiceFinalization>`; never retried automatically.
- `acquiring.invoices.getReceipt(input, options?)`: gets a base64 receipt and
  can request email delivery; returns `Promise<InvoiceReceipt>`.
- `acquiring.invoices.getFiscalChecks(input, options?)`: returns
  `Promise<InvoiceFiscalChecks>`.

Each optional request `options` object accepts `signal?: AbortSignal`.

## Constructor options

- `token: string`: required only for Personal and Acquiring clients; Personal
  credentials are sent only to `/personal/*`, and Acquiring credentials only
  to `/api/merchant/*`.
- `fetch?: FetchLike`: injected Fetch-compatible implementation.
- `baseUrl?: string`: absolute HTTP(S) origin for controlled proxies or tests, https-only when a token is configured unless the host is loopback.
- `timeoutMs?: number`: per-attempt timeout in milliseconds.
- `retry?: { baseDelayMs; maxAttempts; maxDelayMs }`: bounded retry policy for
  safe GET requests. Retries are disabled when omitted.

## Errors

- `MonobankValidationError`: invalid configuration or method input before
  Fetch.
- `MonobankNetworkError`: Fetch failure with reason `network`, `timeout`, or
  `aborted`.
- `MonobankApiError`: non-2xx response; includes status and optional
  `retryAfterMs` and safe upstream message.
- `MonobankResponseValidationError`: successful payload failed runtime schema
  validation.

Errors intentionally do not retain tokens, authorization headers, Request
objects, or raw API payloads.

## Exported runtime values

- Enum-like const objects: `AccountType`, `CashbackType`,
  `AcquiringPaymentScheme`, `AcquiringQrAmountType`,
  `AcquiringStatementStatus`, `InvoicePaymentType`,
  `InvoiceStatus`, `InvoiceCancellationStatus`, `InvoicePaymentSystem`,
  `InvoicePaymentMethod`, `InvoiceWalletStatus`, `DiscountType`, `DiscountMode`,
  `FiscalCheckType`, `FiscalCheckStatus`, `FiscalizationSource`.
- Schemas: `accountSchema`, `bankSyncSchema`, `clientInfoSchema`,
  `currencyRateSchema`, `currencyRatesSchema`, `jarSchema`,
  `managedAccountSchema`, `managedClientSchema`, `statementItemSchema`,
  `statementItemsSchema`, `personalWebhookEventSchema`,
  `merchantDetailsSchema`, `acquiringStatementSchema`,
  `acquiringStatementItemSchema`, `acquiringStatementCancellationSchema`,
  `acquiringSubmerchantSchema`, `acquiringSubmerchantListSchema`,
  `acquiringQrCashierSchema`, `acquiringQrCashierListSchema`,
  `acquiringQrDetailsSchema`, `acquiringWebhookPublicKeySchema`,
  `newInvoiceSchema`, `invoiceStatusSchema`,
  `cancelInvoiceResponseSchema`, `finalizeInvoiceResponseSchema`,
  `receiptSchema`, `invoiceFiscalChecksSchema`.
- Errors: `MonobankApiError`, `MonobankNetworkError`,
  `MonobankResponseValidationError`, `MonobankValidationError`.
- Clients/helpers: `MonobankPublicClient`, `MonobankPersonalClient`,
  `MonobankAcquiringClient`, `parsePersonalWebhookEvent`,
  `verifyAcquiringWebhookSignature`. Resource classes are available through
  parent properties and are not root runtime exports.

See `src/index.ts` for the complete authoritative export list, including types.

## Data rules

- Monetary integers use the currency's minor units.
- Currency codes are numeric ISO 4217 codes.
- Rate and Personal statement timestamps are Unix seconds; Acquiring statement
  request inputs use Unix seconds while response `date` fields use RFC-3339.
- `BankSync.serverTimeMsec` is Unix milliseconds.
- Response schemas preserve unknown additive fields.
- Upstream field spelling is preserved, including `webHookUrl`.

## Safety rules for generated code

- Never expose, log, or commit a real token or banking payload.
- Never mix Personal and Acquiring tokens or send `X-Token` to public
  `/bank/*` endpoints.
- The transport sets `redirect: "error"`, so a redirect surfaces as
  `MonobankNetworkError` and a token is never replayed to another origin. A
  custom `fetch` must honor `RequestInit.redirect` or that protection is lost.
- Never treat webhook parsing as sender authentication.
- For Acquiring webhooks, verify the exact raw body bytes before parsing or
  transforming them. Read `X-Sign`, use the key from
  `acquiring.webhooks.getPublicKey()`, and reject a `false` result.
- Never retry `personal.webhooks.set()`, `acquiring.invoices.create()`,
  `acquiring.invoices.cancel()`, `acquiring.invoices.remove()`,
  `acquiring.invoices.finalize()`, `acquiring.invoices.payDirect()`,
  `acquiring.invoices.syncPayment()`, `acquiring.wallet.pay()`,
  `acquiring.wallet.deleteCard()`, or `acquiring.qr.resetAmount()`
  automatically.
- Never log, persist, or echo raw card details or Apple Pay and Google Pay
  crypto-container values. Prefer `acquiring.invoices.create()` or
  `acquiring.wallet.pay()` over `acquiring.invoices.payDirect()`.
- Do not invent Acquiring APIs beyond the implemented merchant-details,
  submerchant-list, QR, statement, webhook-trust, and invoice-lifecycle
  methods.
- Prefer exported SDK types, schemas, value objects, and error classes over
  duplicate local definitions.
- Never configure a cleartext `http:` `baseUrl` together with a token; the SDK
  rejects it at construction unless the host is loopback.
- Validate environment configuration before constructing the client.
